chunks.sanskrit: mā ci̍da̠nyadvi śaṃ̍sata̠ sakhā̍yo̠ mā ri̍ṣaṇyata |
indra̠mitsto̍tā̠ vṛṣa̍ṇaṃ̠ sacā̍ su̠te muhu̍ru̠kthā ca̍ śaṃsata || 1 ||
a̠va̠kra̠kṣiṇaṃ̍ vṛṣa̠bhaṃ ya̍thā̠juraṃ̠ gāṃ na ca̍rṣaṇī̠saha̍m |
yacci̠ddhi tvā̠ janā̍ i̠me nānā̠ hava̍nta ū̠taye̍ |
a̠smākaṃ̠ brahme̠dami̍ndra bhūtu̠ te'hā̠ viśvā̍ ca̠ vardha̍nam || 3 ||
upa̍ kramasva puru̠rūpa̠mā bha̍ra̠ vājaṃ̠ nedi̍ṣṭhamū̠taye̍ || 4 ||
ma̠he ca̠na tvāma̍driva̠: parā̍ śu̠lkāya̍ deyām |
na sa̠hasrā̍ya̠ nāyutā̍ya vajrivo̠ na śa̠tāya̍ śatāmagha || 5 ||
mā̠tā ca̍ me chadayathaḥ sa̠mā va̍so vasutva̠nāya̠ rādha̍se || 6 ||
kve̍yatha̠ kveda̍si puru̠trā ci̠ddhi te̠ mana̍: |
ala̍rṣi yudhma khajakṛtpuraṃdara̠ pra gā̍ya̠trā a̍gāsiṣuḥ || 7 ||
ye te̠ santi̍ daśa̠gvina̍: śa̠tino̠ ye sa̍ha̠sriṇa̍: |
aśvā̍so̠ ye te̠ vṛṣa̍ṇo raghu̠druva̠stebhi̍rna̠stūya̠mā ga̍hi || 9 ||
ya ṛ̠te ci̍dabhi̠śriṣa̍: pu̠rā ja̠trubhya̍ ā̠tṛda̍: |
saṃdhā̍tā saṃ̠dhiṃ ma̠ghavā̍ purū̠vasu̠riṣka̍rtā̠ vihru̍taṃ̠ puna̍: || 12 ||
mā bhū̍ma̠ niṣṭyā̍ i̠vendra̠ tvadara̍ṇā iva |
sa̠kṛtsu te̍ maha̠tā śū̍ra̠ rādha̍sā̠ 'nu̠ stomaṃ̍ mudīmahi || 14 ||
ti̠raḥ pa̠vitraṃ̍ sasṛ̠vāṃsa̍ ā̠śavo̠ manda̍ntu tugryā̠vṛdha̍: || 15 ||
ā tva1dya sa̠dhastu̍tiṃ vā̠vātu̠: sakhyu̠rā ga̍hi |
upa̍stutirma̠ghonāṃ̠ pra tvā̍va̠tvadhā̍ te vaśmi suṣṭu̠tim || 16 ||
adha̠ jmo adha̍ vā di̠vo bṛ̍ha̠to ro̍ca̠nādadhi̍ |
a̠yā va̍rdhasva ta̠nvā̍ gi̠rā mamā ''jā̠tā su̍krato pṛṇa || 18 ||
indrā̍ya̠ su ma̠dinta̍maṃ̠ somaṃ̍ sotā̠ vare̍ṇyam |
śa̠kra e̍ṇaṃ pīpaya̠dviśva̍yā dhi̠yā hi̍nvā̠naṃ na vā̍ja̠yum || 19 ||
mā tvā̠ soma̍sya̠ galda̍yā̠ sadā̠ yāca̍nna̠haṃ gi̠rā |
bhūrṇiṃ̍ mṛ̠gaṃ na sava̍neṣu cukrudhaṃ̠ ka īśā̍naṃ̠ na yā̍ciṣat || 20 ||
viśve̍ṣāṃ taru̠tāraṃ̍ mada̠cyutaṃ̠ made̠ hi ṣmā̠ dadā̍ti naḥ || 21 ||
śevā̍re̠ vāryā̍ pu̠ru de̠vo martā̍ya dā̠śuṣe̍ |
sa su̍nva̠te ca̍ stuva̠te ca̍ rāsate vi̠śvagū̍rto ariṣṭu̠taḥ || 22 ||
endra̍ yāhi̠ matsva̍ ci̠treṇa̍ deva̠ rādha̍sā |
saro̠ na prā̍syu̠daraṃ̠ sapī̍tibhi̠rā some̍bhiru̠ru sphi̠ram || 23 ||
ā tvā̍ sa̠hasra̠mā śa̠taṃ yu̠ktā rathe̍ hira̠ṇyaye̍ |
bra̠hma̠yujo̠ hara̍ya indra ke̠śino̠ vaha̍ntu̠ soma̍pītaye || 24 ||
ā tvā̠ rathe̍ hira̠ṇyaye̠ harī̍ ma̠yūra̍śepyā |
śi̠ti̠pṛ̠ṣṭhā va̍hatāṃ̠ madhvo̠ andha̍so vi̠vakṣa̍ṇasya pī̠taye̍ || 25 ||
pibā̠ tva1sya gi̍rvaṇaḥ su̠tasya̍ pūrva̠pā i̍va |
ya eko̠ asti̍ daṃ̠sanā̍ ma̠hām̐ u̠gro a̠bhi vra̠taiḥ |
gama̠tsa śi̠prī na sa yo̍ṣa̠dā ga̍ma̠ddhavaṃ̠ na pari̍ varjati || 27 ||
tvaṃ puraṃ̍ cari̠ṣṇvaṃ̍ va̠dhaiḥ śuṣṇa̍sya̠ saṃ pi̍ṇak |
tvaṃ bhā anu̍ caro̠ adha̍ dvi̠tā yadi̍ndra̠ havyo̠ bhuva̍: || 28 ||
mama̍ tvā̠ sūra̠ udi̍te̠ mama̍ ma̠dhyaṃdi̍ne di̠vaḥ |
mama̍ prapi̠tve a̍piśarva̠re va̍sa̠vā stomā̍so avṛtsata || 29 ||
stu̠hi stu̠hīde̠te ghā̍ te̠ maṃhi̍ṣṭhāso ma̠ghonā̍m |
u̠ta vā̠masya̠ vasu̍naściketati̠ yo asti̠ yādva̍: pa̠śuḥ || 3 ||

1

        ya ṛ̠jrā mahyaṃ̍ māma̠he sa̠ha tva̠cā hi̍ra̠ṇyayā̍ |

2

        adha̠ plāyo̍gi̠rati̍ dāsada̠nyānā̍sa̠ṅgo a̍gne da̠śabhi̍: sa̠hasrai̍: |
adho̠kṣaṇo̠ daśa̠ mahyaṃ̠ ruśa̍nto na̠ḷā i̍va̠ sara̍so̠ nira̍tiṣṭhan || 3 ||
taṃ te̠ yavaṃ̠ yathā̠ gobhi̍: svā̠duma̍karma śrī̠ṇanta̍: |
indra̠ itso̍ma̠pā eka̠ indra̍: suta̠pā vi̠śvāyu̍: |
na yaṃ śu̠kro na durā̍śī̠rna tṛ̠prā u̍ru̠vyaca̍sam |
traya̠ indra̍sya̠ somā̍: su̠tāsa̍: santu de̠vasya̍ |
i̠me ta̍ indra̠ somā̍stī̠vrā a̠sme su̠tāsa̍: |
hṛ̠tsu pī̠tāso̍ yudhyante du̠rmadā̍so̠ na surā̍yām |
mā na̍ indra pīya̠tnave̠ mā śardha̍te̠ parā̍ dāḥ |
va̠yamu̍ tvā ta̠dida̍rthā̠ indra̍ tvā̠yanta̠: sakhā̍yaḥ |
i̠cchanti̍ de̠vāḥ su̠nvantaṃ̠ na svapnā̍ya spṛhayanti |
o ṣu pra yā̍hi̠ vāje̍bhi̠rmā hṛ̍ṇīthā a̠bhya1smān |
ā tū ṣi̍ñca̠ kaṇva̍mantaṃ̠ na ghā̍ vidma śavasā̠nāt |
pātā̍ vṛtra̠hā su̠tamā ghā̍ gama̠nnāre a̠smat |
eha harī̍ brahma̠yujā̍ śa̠gmā va̍kṣata̠: sakhā̍yam |
svā̠dava̠: somā̠ ā yā̍hi śrī̠tāḥ somā̠ ā yā̍hi |
stuta̍śca̠ yāstvā̠ vardha̍nti ma̠he rādha̍se nṛ̠mṇāya̍ |
gira̍śca̠ yāste̍ girvāha u̠kthā ca̠ tubhyaṃ̠ tāni̍ |
e̠ṣa e̠tāni̍ cakā̠rendro̠ viśvā̠ yo'ti̍ śṛ̠ṇve |
sani̍tā̠ vipro̠ arva̍dbhi̠rhantā̍ vṛ̠traṃ nṛbhi̠: śūra̍: |
ya ṛ̠te ci̠dgāspa̠debhyo̠ dātsakhā̠ nṛbhya̠: śacī̍vān |
u̠ta su tye pa̍yo̠vṛdhā̍ mā̠kī raṇa̍sya na̠ptyā̍ |
pibā̍ su̠tasya̍ ra̠sino̠ matsvā̍ na indra̠ goma̍taḥ |
ā̠pirno̍ bodhi sadha̠mādyo̍ vṛ̠dhe̠3'smām̐ a̍vantu te̠ dhiya̍: || 1 ||
bhū̠yāma̍ te suma̠tau vā̠jino̍ va̠yaṃ mā na̍: stara̠bhimā̍taye |
i̠mā u̍ tvā purūvaso̠ giro̍ vardhantu̠ yā mama̍ |
a̠yaṃ sa̠hasra̠mṛṣi̍bhi̠: saha̍skṛtaḥ samu̠dra i̍va paprathe |
sa̠tyaḥ so a̍sya mahi̠mā gṛ̍ṇe̠ śavo̍ ya̠jñeṣu̍ vipra̠rājye̍ || 4 ||
indraṃ̍ samī̠ke va̠nino̍ havāmaha̠ indraṃ̠ dhana̍sya sā̠taye̍ || 5 ||
indro̍ ma̠hnā roda̍sī papratha̠cchava̠ indra̠: sūrya̍marocayat |
indre̍ ha̠ viśvā̠ bhuva̍nāni yemira̠ indre̍ suvā̠nāsa̠ inda̍vaḥ || 6 ||
a̠syedindro̍ vāvṛdhe̠ vṛṣṇyaṃ̠ śavo̠ made̍ su̠tasya̠ viṣṇa̍vi |
yenā̠ yati̍bhyo̠ bhṛga̍ve̠ dhane̍ hi̠te yena̠ praska̍ṇva̠māvi̍tha || 9 ||
yenā̍ samu̠dramasṛ̍jo ma̠hīra̠pastadi̍ndra̠ vṛṣṇi̍ te̠ śava̍: |
sa̠dyaḥ so a̍sya mahi̠mā na saṃ̠naśe̠ yaṃ kṣo̠ṇīra̍nucakra̠de || 10 ||
śa̠gdhī na̍ indra̠ yattvā̍ ra̠yiṃ yāmi̍ su̠vīrya̍m |
śa̠gdhi vājā̍ya pratha̠maṃ siṣā̍sate śa̠gdhi stomā̍ya pūrvya || 11 ||
śa̠gdhī no̍ a̠sya yaddha̍ pau̠ramāvi̍tha̠ dhiya̍ indra̠ siṣā̍sataḥ |
śa̠gdhi yathā̠ ruśa̍maṃ̠ śyāva̍kaṃ̠ kṛpa̠mindra̠ prāva̠: sva̍rṇaram || 12 ||
kadu̍ stu̠vanta̍ ṛtayanta de̠vata̠ ṛṣi̠: ko vipra̍ ohate |
ka̠dā havaṃ̍ maghavannindra sunva̠taḥ kadu̍ stuva̠ta ā ga̍maḥ || 14 ||
udu̠ tye madhu̍mattamā̠ gira̠: stomā̍sa īrate |
sa̠trā̠jito̍ dhana̠sā akṣi̍totayo vāja̠yanto̠ rathā̍ iva || 15 ||
kaṇvā̍ iva̠ bhṛga̍va̠: sūryā̍ iva̠ viśva̠middhī̠tamā̍naśuḥ |
yu̠kṣvā hi vṛ̍trahantama̠ harī̍ indra parā̠vata̍: |
i̠me hi te̍ kā̠ravo̍ vāva̠śurdhi̠yā viprā̍so me̠dhasā̍taye |
sa tvaṃ no̍ maghavannindra girvaṇo ve̠no na śṛ̍ṇudhī̠ hava̍m || 18 ||
nirarbu̍dasya̠ mṛga̍yasya mā̠yino̠ niḥ parva̍tasya̠ gā ā̍jaḥ || 19 ||
nira̠gnayo̍ rurucu̠rniru̠ sūryo̠ niḥ soma̍ indri̠yo rasa̍: |
yaṃ me̠ durindro̍ ma̠ruta̠: pāka̍sthāmā̠ kaura̍yāṇaḥ |
yasmā̍ a̠nye daśa̠ prati̠ dhuraṃ̠ vaha̍nti̠ vahna̍yaḥ |
simā̍ pu̠rū nṛṣū̍to a̠syāna̠ve'si̍ praśardha tu̠rvaśe̍ || 1 ||
yadvā̠ rume̠ ruśa̍me̠ śyāva̍ke̠ kṛpa̠ indra̍ mā̠daya̍se̠ sacā̍ |
kaṇvā̍sastvā̠ brahma̍bhi̠: stoma̍vāhasa̠ indrā ya̍ccha̠ntyā ga̍hi || 2 ||
ā̠pi̠tve na̍: prapi̠tve tūya̠mā ga̍hi̠ kaṇve̍ṣu̠ su sacā̠ piba̍ || 3 ||
ā̠muṣyā̠ soma̍mapibaśca̠mū su̠taṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ̠ tadda̍dhiṣe̠ saha̍: || 4 ||
pra ca̍kre̠ saha̍sā̠ saho̍ ba̠bhañja̍ ma̠nyumoja̍sā |
viśve̍ ta indra pṛtanā̠yavo̍ yaho̠ ni vṛ̠kṣā i̍va yemire || 5 ||
pu̠traṃ prā̍va̠rgaṃ kṛ̍ṇute su̠vīrye̍ dā̠śnoti̠ nama̍uktibhiḥ || 6 ||
mā bhe̍ma̠ mā śra̍miṣmo̠grasya̍ sa̠khye tava̍ |
ma̠hatte̠ vṛṣṇo̍ abhi̠cakṣyaṃ̍ kṛ̠taṃ paśye̍ma tu̠rvaśaṃ̠ yadu̍m || 7 ||
sa̠vyāmanu̍ sphi̠gyaṃ̍ vāvase̠ vṛṣā̠ na dā̠no a̍sya roṣati |
madhvā̠ sampṛ̍ktāḥ sāra̠gheṇa̍ dhe̠nava̠stūya̠mehi̠ dravā̠ piba̍ || 8 ||
a̠śvī ra̠thī su̍rū̠pa idgomām̠̐ idi̍ndra te̠ sakhā̍ |
śvā̠tra̠bhājā̠ vaya̍sā sacate̠ sadā̍ ca̠ndro yā̍ti sa̠bhāmupa̍ || 9 ||
ṛśyo̠ na tṛṣya̍nnava̠pāna̠mā ga̍hi̠ pibā̠ somaṃ̠ vaśām̠̐ anu̍ |
upa̍ nū̠naṃ yu̍yuje̠ vṛṣa̍ṇā̠ harī̠ ā ca̍ jagāma vṛtra̠hā || 11 ||
sva̠yaṃ ci̠tsa ma̍nyate̠ dāśu̍ri̠rjano̠ yatrā̠ soma̍sya tṛ̠mpasi̍ |
i̠daṃ te̠ annaṃ̠ yujyaṃ̠ samu̍kṣitaṃ̠ tasyehi̠ pra dra̍vā̠ piba̍ || 12 ||
adhi̍ bra̠dhnasyādra̍yo̠ vi ca̍kṣate su̠nvanto̍ dā̠śva̍dhvaram || 13 ||
upa̍ bra̠dhnaṃ vā̠vātā̠ vṛṣa̍ṇā̠ harī̠ indra̍ma̠pasu̍ vakṣataḥ |
sa śa̍kra śikṣa puruhūta no dhi̠yā tuje̍ rā̠ye vi̍mocana || 15 ||
saṃ na̍: śiśīhi bhu̠rijo̍riva kṣu̠raṃ rāsva̍ rā̠yo vi̍mocana |
tve tanna̍: su̠veda̍mu̠sriyaṃ̠ vasu̠ yaṃ tvaṃ hi̠noṣi̠ martya̍m || 16 ||
vemi̍ tvā pūṣannṛ̠ñjase̠ vemi̠ stota̍va āghṛṇe |
na tasya̍ ve̠myara̍ṇaṃ̠ hi tadva̍so stu̠ṣe pa̠jrāya̠ sāmne̍ || 17 ||
parā̠ gāvo̠ yava̍saṃ̠ kacci̍dāghṛṇe̠ nityaṃ̠ rekṇo̍ amartya |
a̠smākaṃ̍ pūṣannavi̠tā śi̠vo bha̍va̠ maṃhi̍ṣṭho̠ vāja̍sātaye || 18 ||
ā no̠ goma̍ntamaśvinā su̠vīraṃ̍ su̠rathaṃ̍ ra̠yim |
ni ṣu brahma̠ janā̍nāṃ̠ yāvi̍ṣṭaṃ̠ tūya̠mā ga̍tam |
a̠sme ā va̍hataṃ ra̠yiṃ śa̠tava̍ntaṃ saha̠sriṇa̍m |
pu̠ru̠trā ci̠ddhi vāṃ̍ narā vi̠hvaya̍nte manī̠ṣiṇa̍: |
yo ha̍ vāṃ̠ madhu̍no̠ dṛti̠rāhi̍to ratha̠carṣa̍ṇe |
tena̍ no vājinīvasū̠ paśve̍ to̠kāya̠ śaṃ gave̍ |
u̠ta no̍ di̠vyā iṣa̍ u̠ta sindhūm̐̍raharvidā |
ka̠dā vāṃ̍ tau̠gryo vi̍dhatsamu̠dre ja̍hi̠to na̍rā |
e̠tāva̍dvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū̠ ato̍ vā̠ bhūyo̍ aśvinā |
ā no̍ dyu̠mnairā śravo̍bhi̠rā rā̠yā yā̍tamaśvinā |
eha vāṃ̍ pruṣi̠tapsa̍vo̠ vayo̍ vahantu pa̠rṇina̍: |
rathaṃ̍ vā̠manu̍gāyasaṃ̠ ya i̠ṣā varta̍te sa̠ha |
yu̠vaṃ mṛ̠gaṃ jā̍gṛ̠vāṃsaṃ̠ svada̍tho vā vṛṣaṇvasū |
tā me̍ aśvinā sanī̠nāṃ vi̠dyātaṃ̠ navā̍nām |
yathā̍ ciccai̠dyaḥ ka̠śuḥ śa̠tamuṣṭrā̍nāṃ̠ dada̍tsa̠hasrā̠ daśa̠ gonā̍m || 3 ||
yo me̠ hira̍ṇyasaṃdṛśo̠ daśa̠ rājño̠ amaṃ̍hata |
ma̠hām̐ indro̠ ya oja̍sā pa̠rjanyo̍ vṛṣṭi̠mām̐ i̍va |
sama̍sya ma̠nyave̠ viśo̠ viśvā̍ namanta kṛ̠ṣṭaya̍: |
i̠mā a̠bhi pra ṇo̍numo vi̠pāmagre̍ṣu dhī̠taya̍: |
guhā̍ sa̠tīrupa̠ tmanā̠ pra yacchoca̍nta dhī̠taya̍: |
a̠haṃ pra̠tnena̠ manma̍nā̠ gira̍: śumbhāmi kaṇva̠vat |
ye tvāmi̍ndra̠ na tu̍ṣṭu̠vuṝṣa̍yo̠ ye ca̍ tuṣṭu̠vuḥ |
ni śuṣṇa̍ indra dharṇa̠siṃ vajraṃ̍ jaghantha̠ dasya̍vi |
ya i̠me roda̍sī ma̠hī sa̍mī̠cī sa̠maja̍grabhīt |
ya i̍ndra̠ yata̍yastvā̠ bhṛga̍vo̠ ye ca̍ tuṣṭu̠vuḥ |
i̠māsta̍ indra̠ pṛśna̍yo ghṛ̠taṃ du̍hata ā̠śira̍m |
ā na̍ indra ma̠hīmiṣaṃ̠ puraṃ̠ na da̍rṣi̠ goma̍tīm |
a̠bhi vra̠jaṃ na ta̍tniṣe̠ sūra̍ upā̠kaca̍kṣasam |
taṃ tvā̍ ha̠viṣma̍tī̠rviśa̠ upa̍ bruvata ū̠taye̍ |
kaṇvā̍sa indra te ma̠tiṃ viśve̍ vardhanti̠ pauṃsya̍m |
i̠māṃ ma̍ indra suṣṭu̠tiṃ ju̠ṣasva̠ pra su māma̍va |
u̠ta bra̍hma̠ṇyā va̠yaṃ tubhyaṃ̍ pravṛddha vajrivaḥ |
a̠bhi kaṇvā̍ anūṣa̠tā''po̠ na pra̠vatā̍ ya̠tīḥ |
ā no̍ yāhi parā̠vato̠ hari̍bhyāṃ harya̠tābhyā̍m |
anu̍ tvā̠ roda̍sī u̠bhe ca̠kraṃ na va̠rtyeta̍śam |
a̠smākaṃ̍ tvā su̠tām̐ upa̍ vī̠tapṛ̍ṣṭhā a̠bhi praya̍: |
i̠māṃ su pū̠rvyāṃ dhiyaṃ̠ madho̍rghṛ̠tasya̍ pi̠pyuṣī̍m |
vapa̍nti ma̠ruto̠ mihaṃ̠ pra ve̍payanti̠ parva̍tān |
ni yadyāmā̍ya vo gi̠rirni sindha̍vo̠ vidha̍rmaṇe |
trīṇi̠ sarāṃ̍si̠ pṛśna̍yo dudu̠hre va̠jriṇe̠ madhu̍ |
maru̍to̠ yaddha̍ vo di̠vaḥ su̍mnā̠yanto̠ havā̍mahe |
yū̠yaṃ hi ṣṭhā su̍dānavo̠ rudrā̍ ṛbhukṣaṇo̠ dame̍ |
ā no̍ ra̠yiṃ ma̍da̠cyutaṃ̍ puru̠kṣuṃ vi̠śvadhā̍yasam |
ye dra̠psā i̍va̠ roda̍sī̠ dhama̠ntyanu̍ vṛ̠ṣṭibhi̍: |
yenā̠va tu̠rvaśaṃ̠ yaduṃ̠ yena̠ kaṇvaṃ̍ dhana̠spṛta̍m |
i̠mā u̍ vaḥ sudānavo ghṛ̠taṃ na pi̠pyuṣī̠riṣa̍: |
na̠hi ṣma̠ yaddha̍ vaḥ pu̠rā stome̍bhirvṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
samu̠ tye ma̍ha̠tīra̠paḥ saṃ kṣo̠ṇī samu̠ sūrya̍m |
vi vṛ̠traṃ pa̍rva̠śo ya̍yu̠rvi parva̍tām̐ arā̠jina̍: |
ka̠dā ga̍cchātha maruta i̠tthā vipraṃ̠ hava̍mānam |
sa̠ho ṣu ṇo̠ vajra̍hastai̠: kaṇvā̍so a̠gniṃ ma̠rudbhi̍: |
o ṣu vṛṣṇa̠: praya̍jyū̠nā navya̍se suvi̠tāya̍ |
a̠gnirhi jāni̍ pū̠rvyaśchando̠ na sūro̍ a̠rciṣā̍ |
pibā̍tho aśvinā̠ madhu̠ kaṇvā̍nāṃ̠ sava̍ne su̠tam || 3 ||
pu̠traḥ kaṇva̍sya vāmi̠ha su̠ṣāva̍ so̠myaṃ madhu̍ || 4 ||
svāhā̠ stoma̍sya vardhanā̠ pra ka̍vī dhī̠tibhi̍rnarā || 5 ||
yacci̠ddhi vāṃ̍ pu̠ra ṛṣa̍yo juhū̠re'va̍se narā |
ari̍prā̠ vṛtra̍hantamā̠ tā no̍ bhūtaṃ mayo̠bhuvā̍ || 9 ||
kṛ̠taṃ na̍ ṛ̠tviyā̍vato̠ mā no̍ rīradhataṃ ni̠de || 13 ||
ā no̍ gantaṃ riśādase̠maṃ stomaṃ̍ purubhujā |
ā no̍ gantaṃ mayo̠bhuvā'śvi̍nā śa̠mbhuvā̍ yu̠vam |
pra vāṃ̠ stomā̍: suvṛ̠ktayo̠ giro̍ vardhantvaśvinā |
puru̍trā̠ vṛtra̍hantamā̠ tā no̍ bhūtaṃ puru̠spṛhā̍ || 22 ||
prāsmai̍ yacchatamavṛ̠kaṃ pṛ̠thu ccha̠rdiryu̍yu̠taṃ yā arā̍tayaḥ || 1 ||
a̠yaṃ vāṃ̍ gha̠rmo a̍śvinā̠ stome̍na̠ pari̍ ṣicyate |
a̠yaṃ somo̠ madhu̍mānvājinīvasū̠ yena̍ vṛ̠traṃ cike̍tathaḥ || 4 ||
a̠yaṃ vāṃ̍ va̠tso ma̠tibhi̠rna vi̍ndhate ha̠viṣma̍ntaṃ̠ hi gaccha̍thaḥ || 6 ||
ā nū̠naṃ ra̠ghuva̍rtaniṃ̠ rathaṃ̍ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā |
ā vāṃ̠ stomā̍ i̠me mama̠ nabho̠ na cu̍cyavīrata || 8 ||
yadvāṃ̍ ka̠kṣīvām̐̍ u̠ta yadvya̍śva̠ ṛṣi̠ryadvāṃ̍ dī̠rghata̍mā ju̠hāva̍ |
pṛthī̠ yadvāṃ̍ vai̠nyaḥ sāda̍neṣve̠vedato̍ aśvinā cetayethām || 10 ||
yā̠taṃ cha̍rdi̠ṣpā u̠ta na̍: para̠spā bhū̠taṃ ja̍ga̠tpā u̠ta na̍stanū̠pā |
yadindre̍ṇa sa̠rathaṃ̍ yā̠tho a̍śvinā̠ yadvā̍ vā̠yunā̠ bhava̍tha̠: samo̍kasā |
ā nū̠naṃ yā̍tamaśvine̠mā ha̠vyāni̍ vāṃ hi̠tā |
i̠me somā̍so̠ adhi̍ tu̠rvaśe̠ yadā̍vi̠me kaṇve̍ṣu vā̠matha̍ || 14 ||
tena̍ nū̠naṃ vi̍ma̠dāya̍ pracetasā cha̠rdirva̠tsāya̍ yacchatam || 15 ||
pra bo̍dhayoṣo a̠śvinā̠ pra de̍vi sūnṛte mahi |
yadu̍ṣo̠ yāsi̍ bhā̠nunā̠ saṃ sūrye̍ṇa rocase |
yadāpī̍tāso aṃ̠śavo̠ gāvo̠ na du̠hra ūdha̍bhiḥ |
pra dyu̠mnāya̠ pra śava̍se̠ pra nṛ̠ṣāhyā̍ya̠ śarma̍ṇe |
yadvā̍ samu̠dre adhyākṛ̍te gṛ̠he'ta̠ ā yā̍tamaśvinā || 1 ||
bṛha̠spatiṃ̠ viśvā̍nde̠vām̐ a̠haṃ hu̍va̠ indrā̠viṣṇū̍ a̠śvinā̍vāśu̠heṣa̍sā || 2 ||
tyā nva1śvinā̍ huve su̠daṃsa̍sā gṛ̠bhe kṛ̠tā |
yayo̠radhi̠ pra ya̠jñā a̍sū̠re santi̍ sū̠raya̍: |
tā ya̠jñasyā̍dhva̠rasya̠ prace̍tasā sva̠dhābhi̠ryā piba̍taḥ so̠myaṃ madhu̍ || 4 ||
yaddru̠hyavyana̍vi tu̠rvaśe̠ yadau̍ hu̠ve vā̠matha̠ mā ga̍tam || 5 ||
yada̠ntari̍kṣe̠ pata̍thaḥ purubhujā̠ yadve̠me roda̍sī̠ anu̍ |
tvama̍gne vrata̠pā a̍si de̠va ā martye̠ṣvā |
martā̠ ama̍rtyasya te̠ bhūri̠ nāma̍ manāmahe |
pu̠ru̠trā hi sa̠dṛṅṅasi̠ viśo̠ viśvā̠ anu̍ pra̠bhuḥ |
pra̠tno hi ka̠mīḍyo̍ adhva̠reṣu̍ sa̠nācca̠ hotā̠ navya̍śca̠ satsi̍ |
svāṃ cā̍gne ta̠nvaṃ̍ pi̠praya̍svā̠'smabhyaṃ̍ ca̠ saubha̍ga̠mā ya̍jasva || 10 ||
